name: apple-reminders
description: Inspect and safely manage Apple Reminders through a public EventKit-backed CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and safely manage reminders, lists, and due dates.
interface.longDescription: Inspect, search, create, edit, complete, and delete Apple Reminders through remindctl's public EventKit integration, with stable-ID targeting, confirmation gates, and read-back verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-reminders to inspect or safely manage my Apple Reminders.
